title: Quarter Volume (modified) NEBNext Ultra II FS DNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina Part 1 of 3
author: Opentrons
materials: End Prep and Adapter Ligation. Links: * [Part

With this protocol, your robot can perform a modified Quarter Volume NEBNext Ultra II FS DNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina protocol described by the [Experimental Protocol](https://s3.amazonaws.com/pf-upload-01/u-4256/0/2021-05-07/ia13rz0/Quarter%20volume%20NEB%20Next%20Ultra%20II%20DNA%20Library%20Prep%20Kit%20for%20Illumina.docx). [NEB Instruction Manual for NEBNext](https://s3.amazonaws.com/pf-upload-01/u-4256/0/2021-05-07/ce23ruu/manualE7805.pdf). This is part 1 of the protocol: End prep and adapter ligation. This protocol assumes up to 96 input samples and follows the attached experimental protocol. After the steps carried out in this protocol (part 1), proceed with part
Combine end prep reagents with the initial DNA samples.

steps.title: Combine end prep reagents
steps.instruction: Combine the end‑prep reagents from the Quarter Volume (modified) NEBNext Ultra II FS DNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina with each initial DNA sample (up to 96 input samples).

steps.title: Run end prep thermocycler
steps.instruction: Place the reactions in a thermocycler and run the end‑prep program as described in the kit protocol (Part 1 of 3).

steps.title: Adapter ligation and USER treatment
steps.instruction: Add the adapter‑ligation reagents and USER enzyme to each reaction and incubate according to the kit instructions.
